name: demo-stats
description: Stats band under the split Get a Demo booking hero (live #ap-demo-stats on /test-calendar-demo-weekly/): three big gradient numbers that count up on first view, each over a label. On desktop it is 128px tall (108px on short screens) so it and the hero fill one screen.

items.description: Numbers. Each: value (e.g. 10,000+; the digits count up, prefix/suffix stay), label.
